name: goeteia-page-substrate
purpose: context injected with a request so a model that has never seen Goeteia emits a page that compiles and runs the first time

host.shape: the .ss IS the browser half: its top level runs in a page that is already open
host.filesystem: none -- call-with-output-file fails at run time

toolchain.note: verify compiles the source with the self-hosted compiler and drives the result in one step; its verdict format and check-spec schema are documented in docs/verify.md

files.role: always inject: the browser-half page shape and its two hosts, the (web dom) vocabulary, import sets, the DO/DONT table

files.name: static
teaches: the browser-half shape: the page exists, #app is the host
create-element / append-child! / set-text! / set-attribute!
set-inner-html! delivers a string, not elements
css->string; unit digits as written, third operand is the width

files.name: interactive
teaches: a control is built and wired by the program, never preset
add-event-listener! and (js-undefined)
the num helper at the JS boundary
fl->fx truncates: round with +0.5

files.name: mesh3d
teaches: fx-init! takes the canvas the page already has
fx-program! wires a shader from its own forms
the (gfx mesh) generators and their full-extent sizes
fx-loop!: one bridge call per frame
(gfx mat) column-major mat4s and m4-mul parent-first

files.name: shader
teaches: glsl->string is pure; shaders compose
(fl W F [width]) digits as written, strings for more places
shader functions with parameters, and return
reserved words are refused at generation time
fx-fullscreen! and the auto-wired u_time/u_resolution

files.name: animated
for: a rig, an arm, an orrery
animation and interaction in one scene
teaches: a hierarchy is m4-mul: parent frame first, child transform second
putting a pivot at a limb end instead of its middle
controls writing state that the frame callback reads
sliders entering the chain at different depths stay independent
the skinned-asset round trip, in brief

injection.task: page with state, controls or forms
a rig, an orrery, or several controllable degrees of freedom
unknown, or a page mixing several of the above

verification.what: every example is put through goeteia verify -- all four stages: compile, smoke against a mock DOM and a recording WebGL context, draw/interact, then the custom checks recorded as this file's "checks" field -- and every tier document is asserted to carry its example source byte for byte, within budget, with these byte counts matching the files on disk
mutations: a fixnum operand is injected into an fl* inside t3's frame callback: the smoke stage must go red, which is what proves the harness runs code rather than counting files

a line of an example is edited without updating the document that shows it: the byte-for-byte assertion must go red, which is what keeps the code a model is handed identical to the code that was verified
